tools.name: get_workflow_guide
tools.description: Returns required inputs, ordered steps, example requests and review criteria for eight supported Magic Hour workflows. Use when planning a generation, not to run one. Requires authentication but does not check account eligibility or spend credits.

tools.name: upload_chatgpt_image
tools.description: Uploads a PNG, JPEG or WebP image attached in ChatGPT to the connected Magic Hour account. Use this for native ChatGPT photo attachments instead of asking the chat's file runtime to PUT bytes to get_upload_urls. Pass the returned file_path to the existing image or video generation tool. Accepts one image up to 20 MiB. Does not generate media or spend generation credits.

image.description: The native attached image. ChatGPT supplies download_url and file_id; direct MCP callers must supply that file object, not a bare file ID, filename or local path.

tools.name: upload_chatgpt_media
tools.description: Uploads one native ChatGPT attachment to the connected Magic Hour account: PNG/JPEG/WebP images, MP4/MOV/WebM video, or MP3/WAV/M4A/FLAC/Ogg/WebM audio, up to 20 MiB. Set media_type to the attachment's actual kind, not the requested output: image, video or audio. For multiple references, call separately and keep each returned file_path paired with the intended input. Pass the real attachment through the file parameter; a bare file ID, filename or chat-local path is not the raw MCP file object. Does not generate media or spend generation credits.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Checks that the Magic Hour server is reachable. Use for connectivity troubleshooting; it does not validate API credentials or account access. Makes no media or project changes.

tools.name: wait_for_video_project
tools.description: Polls a video project until it completes, errors, is canceled or times out. Use with the id returned by a video create tool. Read-only; returns download URLs when complete. After a timeout, resume with the same id rather than creating another generation. Use signed download URLs exactly as returned. Does not inline video content.

tools.name: wait_for_image_project
tools.description: Polls an image project until it completes, errors, is canceled or times out. Use with the id returned by an image create tool. Read-only; returns the project and download URLs, with optional inline image previews sharing an 8 MiB total limit. After a timeout, resume with the same id rather than creating another generation. Use signed download URLs exactly as returned.

tools.name: wait_for_audio_project
tools.description: Polls an audio project until it completes, errors, is canceled or times out. Use with the id returned by an audio create tool. Read-only; returns the project and download URLs, with optional inline audio previews sharing an 8 MiB total limit. After a timeout, resume with the same id rather than creating another generation. Use signed download URLs exactly as returned.

tools.name: fetch_image_download
tools.description: Fetch a completed project's image as inline MCP image content for compatible clients. Use the exact signed download URL, including query parameters. Requires HTTPS at the configured Magic Hour media host. Read-only; limited to 8 MiB, or a smaller requested max_bytes. Use the signed URL directly for larger files.

tools.name: fetch_audio_download
tools.description: Fetch a completed project's audio as inline MCP audio content for compatible clients. Use the exact signed download URL, including query parameters. Requires HTTPS at the configured Magic Hour media host. Read-only; limited to 8 MiB, or a smaller requested max_bytes. Use the signed URL directly for larger files.

tools.name: fetch_video_download
tools.description: Fetch a completed project's video as an embedded MCP binary resource for compatible clients. Use the exact signed download URL, including query parameters. Requires HTTPS at the configured Magic Hour media host. Read-only; limited to 8 MiB, or a smaller requested max_bytes. Use the signed URL directly for larger files.

tools.name: get_account_info
tools.description: Returns credit balance and subscription details for the connected account. Use to inspect account information before choosing generation settings. Use tier, not the subscription name or credit balance, for plan access. Read-only; this is not a request-specific cost quote or model-eligibility check.

tools.name: list_saved_items
tools.description: Lists the account's active saved characters, references, voice recordings, moodboards and brand kits, newest first. Reusable paths are in each item's assets[].file_path; temporary signed URLs support preview/download. Read-only; pass next_cursor as cursor for the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of saved items to return. Defaults to 20.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from the previous response's next_cursor.

tools.description:
Use only with the user's own likeness or content they are authorized to use. Do not use for impersonation, deception, sexual content, or content involving minors.

Replaces a subject in a video with a character from a reference image, or transfers the video's motion onto that character. Starts a background job that costs credits; returns a project id for wait_for_video_project. Before choosing settings, read get_account_info and the current parameter constraints. A listed model, resolution, duration or count is not necessarily available together or on this account. name.description: Give your video a custom name for easy identification.

model.description:
Model to use. Defaults to `wan-animate`.

* **`wan-animate`**: 480p, 720p. Supports `points` subject selection.
* **`kling-3.0`**: 720p, 1080p. Clips of 3–10 seconds in `replace` mode or 3–30 seconds in `animate` mode. Picks the main person automatically, so `points` are rejected.
* **`minimax-h3`**: 480p, 720p, 1080p. Clips of 1–60 seconds in `replace` mode or 1–60 seconds in `animate` mode. Subject `points` are `replace`-only; `animate` with `selection_mode` `point` returns 422, and with `auto` or no `selection_mode` the points are ignored.

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

assets.description: Source video and reference character image for the job.

mode.description: Processing mode. `replace` swaps the detected subject with your reference character. `animate` transfers motion from the video onto your character image.

prompt.description: Optional direction. Supported by kling-3.0, minimax-h3.

selection_mode.description: How to locate the subject in the source video. `auto` detects a person automatically. `point` uses your `points` to mark the subject and is supported by `wan-animate`, `minimax-h3`. `minimax-h3` subject `points` are `replace`-only; `animate` with `selection_mode` `point` returns 422, and with `auto` or no `selection_mode` the points are ignored. Defaults to `auto`.

position_x.description: Horizontal pixel coordinate in the source video frame at `time_seconds`, measured from the left edge.

position_y.description: Vertical pixel coordinate in the source video frame at `time_seconds`, measured from the top edge.

time_seconds.description: Timestamp on the source video timeline in seconds. Uses the same clock as `start_seconds` and `end_seconds`.

points.description: On-frame markers for manual subject selection. Required when `selection_mode` is `point`. Ignored when `selection_mode` is `auto` or omitted. Rejected for models without subject selection (supported by `wan-animate`, `minimax-h3`). `minimax-h3` subject `points` are `replace`-only; `animate` with `selection_mode` `point` returns 422, and with `auto` or no `selection_mode` the points are ignored.
